title: Annotatio IV §.XXI: proven by Reformed public confessions — Cosin and the Lutheran Helmstedt abbot
pass_a_gloss: This is proved both by these men’s public Confessions and by the Writings of more celebrated Private Doctors, still most recently collected and reviewed from the Harmony of Confessions and their other Books — both by the Reformed Cosin, Bishop of Durham, in the History of Papal Transubstantiation, the whole of ch. 2, and by the Lutheran Abbot of Lutheren, Doctor and Professor at Helmstedt, in the Consideration of Controversies from p. 492 to the following page.
pass_b_english: Proof stands in the Reformed public confessions and celebrated private doctors’ writings — freshly gathered from the Harmony of Confessions and related books.
Cosin (Durham) treats it in his History of Papal Transubstantiation ch. 2 entire; the Lutheran Helmstedt abbot in Consideration of Controversies from p. 492 on.
source_text: Probant id tam Confessiones horum publicæ, quam Privatorum Doctorum celebriorum Scripta, adhuc novissimè ex Harmonia Confessionum aliisque eorum Libris, collecta & recensita, tùm à Reformato Cosino, Episcopo Dunelmensi, in Historia Transsubstantiationis Papalis, cap. 2. integro, tùm à Lutherano Abbate Lutherensi, Doctore & Professore Helmstadiensi in Consideratione Controversiarum à pag. 492. ad pag. seq.
